context_requirements: Expression of the drug's primary target (e.g., cardiac ion channel or adrenergic receptor) at sufficient levels
Functional coupling of the target to transcriptional signaling pathways
Cellular context permissive for transcriptional remodeling (e.g., not terminally differentiated)
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple antiarrhythmic drugs in these lines
Enrichment of ion channel or adrenergic signaling gene sets among differentially expressed landmark genes
